head: hex
notes: NSN 5306-00-226-4825 lists GM 9417950 as 5/16-18 x ~.72-.75 hex, grade 8. eBay NOS lists it as cam sprocket bolt 5/16 x 3/4. A fan-drive listing says a 5/16-18 x 3/4 grade 8 bolt replaces 9417950. One camaros.net AMK table puts 9417950-P178 near a 3/8-16X7/8 heading, but the mapping is ambiguous and not used. wbparts/eBay returned 403; quotes are search snippets.
